project.client: Ian Piercy (Distributor) for Ramsey Town Commissioners
project.job: Close Woirrey and Albert Road, Ramsey, Isle of Man
project.model_title: ES26-071 Close Woirrey and Albert Road, Ramsey, Isle of Man - Quotation Q01

views.title: Foundation ICF and ground-floor slab
views.desc: Nudura ICF foundation walls under both blocks, 2 courses (914 mm) below FFL +6.080 (6in XR35 external, 6in Standard compartment and core walls), and the ground-floor slab: 75 screed / 120 insulation / 200 RC ground-bearing slab (engineer to design).

views.title: Ground-floor ICF, partitions, windows and doors
views.desc: Ground-floor ICF walls with the openings (25 mm head and jamb overfly), the ground-floor timber partitions inside the flats (38x89 C16; 38x140 + 9 OSB on the walls drawn on the wall layer), windows, doors and the glazed corner-bay and stair screens.

views.title: First-floor slab, stairs and lift
views.desc: First-floor 215 profiled metal-deck composite slab with 30 insulation and 75 screed (toggle), bearing into the ICF core (engineer to design); precast three-flight stair round the lift, ground to first floor; 13-person lift car and pit.

views.title: First-floor ICF, partitions and windows
views.desc: First-floor ICF walls (FF FFL +3,090 above GF), the first-floor timber partitions, windows, balcony doors and screens.

views.title: Second-floor slab and stairs
views.desc: Second-floor 215 metal-deck composite slab, insulation and screed (toggle); precast stair first to second floor with the well-edge guarding.

views.title: Second-floor ICF, partitions and windows
views.desc: Second-floor ICF walls (SF FFL +6,165) to the wall top +8,815, the compartment walls carried up to 50 below the top of the rafters, the second-floor timber partitions, windows and screens.

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: 45 degree hipped roofs with flat tops (+11,535) over both blocks, framed members only (rafters, hips, valleys, jack rafters, crown plate, flat-top and ceiling joists, wall plates); the truss manufacturer designs the trussed flat-top set. Roof planes and coverings not shown.
